title: Puppet rigs
summary: Cut-out character puppets from rig.json: one CALayer per part, looping keyframe motion from ui.json.
description: PuppetRig loads an art-pipeline rig (Art/<name>/rig.json: layers, pivots, groups); PuppetStage draws it as CALayers and loops the rig's motion (ui.json `puppet.<rig>`). Used by the home scene and the event badges; the rigs themselves are skin slots (skin/art.json `rigs`).
